body.statement: Fix any admissible profile selected without assignments or outcomes. Under \(\mathsf{Sample}_{ZP}\), every \(Z\in\Omega\) is incident to exactly \(\nu(a,b)\) compatible ordered paired partitions. Conditional on the reported \(P\), the induced pattern \(z^{\mathrm{obs}}\) is uniform on \(H(a,b)\), equivalently \(Z\) is uniform over the full assignments compatible with \(P\). The sampler is equivariant under independent relabelings of \(B\) and \(S\).
body.justification: Correct conditional sampling is required for the frontier to define an exact test rather than only a combinatorial optimum.
body.gap: Basse et al. derive uniform exposure orbits from equivariance, but unequal rectangular auxiliary partitions require an explicit constant-fiber count.
body.consumer: The theorem supplies a rejection-free implementation of every catalogued event under unequal buyer and seller population sizes.
